products.name: LMSYS Arena Models
products.note: Model evaluation platform; crowdsourced benchmarking; research transparency; no production use

profile_text.body:
LMSYS operates lmarena.ai, a community-driven platform for evaluating and ranking large language models, image models, and code models. The site describes itself as an official AI ranking and LLM leaderboard where users can chat with models, compare outputs side by side, and vote on results, with those votes shaping a public leaderboard. User conversations and certain personal information are disclosed to the relevant AI providers and may be made public to support research, and conversations are also used for automated evaluation in which prompts are later sent to AI providers to score and compare their models.

The site's held facts classify LMSYS as a nonprofit organization. Its tracked product, listed under Chat and General LLMs, is LMSYS Arena Models, described as a model evaluation platform built around crowdsourced benchmarking and research transparency, with a note that it is not intended for production use. No litigation, patent filings, MCP servers, or SEC records are on file for the organization.
